name: InterGenOS Quick Settings Panel Shortcut
description: Re-routes the Wi-Fi and Bluetooth quick-settings menu arrows to open their Settings panel directly, instead of the inline submenu. GNOME 49 quick-toggle submenus render at full natural height with no scroll area in the subtree, so on a short (e.g. 1366x768) panel the Wi-Fi network list overflows and the menu slides off-screen (PI-Welcome-2). Scrolling/height-clamp was attempted and ruled out; the CSS trim only fits the short power submenu. Targets NMWirelessToggle + BluetoothToggle only (Bluetooth proactively, same overflow class with many paired devices); power/wired/VPN keep their short inline menus untouched. Default-enabled via the InterGenOS gschema-override.
